description.text: Pokémon Trading Card Game Classic, the English edition of a premium box designed with the Japanese design office nendo to be played for good with only its three decks, Venusaur & Lugia ex, Charizard & Ho-Oh ex and Blastoise & Suicune ex. It was sold at the Pokémon Center and local game stores from late 2023. Its cards carry no regulation mark, so cards from every era can share a deck, and apart from basic Energy they can't be used in official tournaments. Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise use their Base Set illustrations and keep their Energy Trans, Energy Burn and Rain Dance powers, now as Abilities, while the three Pokémon ex and a Pokémon Tool for each deck are new. This set is the Charizard & Ho-Oh ex deck: Charizard's Energy Burn makes all its Energy count as Fire, Ho-Oh ex attaches up to two basic Energy from the discard pile to your Pokémon, and the new Tool Scorching Charcoal adds 100 damage to Charizard's attack, for 200. The cloth-covered folding playmat holds the three decks and a toolbox of stackable damage counters, raised Poison and Burn markers and metal orbs that replace the coin: an orb rolled down its spiral that lands in a white-bordered hole counts as heads.
